name: Bismarck (United States)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and red within a yellow border, the white bearing BISM★RCK in dark blue with a yellow star for the A, the red bearing NORTH DAKOTA in white, and a blue disc with a white star and a yellow ribbon at the hoist.
history: Bismarck is the capital city of North Dakota and the county seat of Burleigh County. The flag was adopted in 1986 (adopted officially in September 1986, according to Flags of the World quoting American City Flags).
